hero.title: SiteSynergy assessment and reporting tools
hero.description: From screening candidate sites to preparing reports for the next project stage.

siteSelection.title: Site Selection
siteSelection.description: Compare potential solar sites using relevant land, grid, and resource data in one workflow. Structured screening can help teams identify constraints earlier and focus fieldwork on promising locations. Results still need local verification and project-specific review.

f1.title: Screen land constraints
f1.desc: Identify unsuitable locations earlier in the evaluation process.

f2.title: Compare generation potential
f2.desc: Review solar resource information alongside other site factors.

f3.title: Organize the workflow
f3.desc: Reduce manual comparison across disconnected data sources.

reports.title: Project Reports
reports.description: Prepare project-specific technical, environmental, and economic reports based on the available site information and agreed scope. Reports can support planning and permit preparation; regulatory acceptance depends on the relevant authority and project requirements.

f1.title: Technical and economic view
f1.desc: Bring key site findings and assumptions into a structured report.

f2.title: Environmental considerations
f2.desc: Document relevant constraints for further review.

f3.title: Planning support
f3.desc: Use findings to prepare the next stage of project assessment.

cta.title: Discuss your project location with us

pricing.question: How is pricing determined?
pricing.answer: We prepare a project-specific proposal after reviewing the scope, required data, and expected deliverables.

dataSources.question: What data is used in an assessment?
dataSources.answer: Sources depend on the region and project type. We discuss available data and its limitations before work begins.

turnaround.question: How long does an assessment take?
turnaround.answer: Delivery depends on the area, data quality, and type of report. The project proposal sets out the expected timeline.

security.question: How should I share sensitive project information?
security.answer: Do not send confidential material through the public form or ordinary email. Contact us first to arrange a suitable exchange method.

geographic.question: Is my project area covered?
geographic.answer: Data coverage varies by region. Send us the location and project requirements so we can assess feasibility.
